scope: Amlogic v2 USB burning protocol as implemented by the Yandex Station Max vendor BSP

tree.note: sparse checkout: only 7 of 40 v2_burning files are on disk; the rest were read from git HEAD
tree.mirror: /home/leftymods/UB-AtriOS/drivers/usb/gadget/v2_burning (2017 copy, byte-identical usb_pcd.c/optimus_transform.c apart from style/refactor)

files.role: descriptors + EP0 vendor request dispatch + bulk flow control
download/upload command parsing, media write, verify, burn_complete
buffer map, work modes, burn-complete choices, identifyWaitTime
64K slot buffering, 64K-multiple rule, upload command data

findings.claim: VID/PID = 0x1b8e:0xc003, bcdUSB 0x0200, bcdDevice 0x0007, MPS0 64, no string descriptors
1 interface, class 0xff, 2 bulk EPs: 0x81 IN and 0x02 OUT, 512-byte MPS at high speed
USE_FULL_SPEED is gated on CONFIG_AML_USB_BURN_FULL_SPPED, which is not defined for yandex_station_v1
Identify (0x20) returns {ver_major, ver_minor, stage_major, stage_minor}; TPL reports stage_minor=16
Download command data is a 32-byte struct {retry,len,seq,checksum,alg(u16),ackLen(u16),reserv[12]}
Checksum algorithms advertised: 0x00ee none, 0x00ef add-sum, 0x00f0 crc32; only add-sum is implemented
add_sum() is declared but not defined anywhere in the tree
image_check() is declared but not defined anywhere in the tree; header crc field is not verified
Non-final data packets must be a multiple of 64 KiB
Busy replies are the ASCII strings 'Continue:32' (download) and 'Continue:34' (bulkcmd)', success is 'OK!!' with ackLen bytes
Burn mode entry: boot_id==5 (AO_SEC_GP_CFG0[3:0]) or AO_SEC_GP_CFG7 bit31, plus PREG_STICKY_REG2 gate 0x1b8ec003/0x1b8ec004
set_usb_boot_function(CLEAR_USB_BOOT) is an SMC 0x82000043 with x1=1 into BL31, not SCPI
Env drives burn: usb_burning=update 1000 and try_auto_burn=update 700 750
Unknown text commands fall through to run_command() (remote shell risk)
erase_bootloader erases the 'boot' partition when ROM_BOOT_SKIP_BOOT_ENABLED_4_USB is undefined (it is undefined here)

agreements: same VID/PID 0x1b8e:0xc003 for both BootROM and TPL
same request codes + REQ_GET_AMLC 0x50 / REQ_WRITE_AMLC 0x60 / REQ_PASSWORD 0x35 / REQ_NOP 0x36 exist only in the ROM path
download uses 0x10000-byte blocks, seq starting at 0, ackLen 0x200, alg add-sum
tool skips bootloader download when stage_minor == 16

unknowns: who writes PREG_STICKY_REG2=0x1b8ec003 and what 0x1b8ec004 means
exact wValue/wIndex sent by the Windows tool for 0x32 (only wIndex==0xffff && wLength==0x20 special case is visible in target code)
header crc algorithm (tested crc32 variants do not match 0xbc03b96b)
whether the vendor tool requires full-speed fallback on any port
